title: 4chan whistleblower: nukes, jets and boats sent after the craft never came back

tellings.quote: He's like, "We've tried to um we've sent nukes after it like on submarines. We've sent jets. We've scrambled like boats. Like none of them come back.

plain: An anonymous poster on 4chan, an online message board, claimed that some craft in the ocean near the Bahamas had swallowed everything sent after it: nuclear weapons fired from submarines, jets and boats, and "none of them come back." The guest Chris Ramsay relays this to Michels from the poster's thread, quoting the whistleblower as saying "we've sent nukes after it." If true, the military would be facing something under the sea that it cannot touch.
